entries.zh: 搅扰，扰乱；使（身体的）劳作不得安宁
entries.en: to disturb, unsettle; to throw the labours of the body into disquiet

entries.zh: 寝食不安；忧心得睡卧不宁、饮食无味
entries.en: restless with anxiety; unable to eat or sleep
entries.notes: 西语词头整栏[残]，无从据西语定项；释义依汉字栏“寝食不安”与注音 chin sit pur an。

entries.en: to help, assist a person
entries.notes: 词头 ynquirir（探问）与汉字栏“佐人（助人）”对应关系不明，注音 cho lang 合“佐／做人”，按汉字本义释义。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语栏[空]，汉字“错冒”（冐为“冒”之古体）与注音 ho mo 均非通行词组，音义无法定夺。

entries.en: to examine and interrogate; to inquire, ask
entries.notes: 西语行末[残]，据可读部分 ynquirir: preguntar 与汉字、注音定项；注音 sim char 当同“审查”。

entries.en: to inquire secretly; to sound out, pry
entries.notes: 官话栏 “tam fia. idz.” 未能确解（idz. 疑为未展开缩写，tam fia 或为“探訪”）；汉字栏单“打”，注音 fa: fa teng 含“打”“打听”两读。

entries.en: to inquire, ask; to seek information by inquiry
to investigate thoroughly; to examine and pursue a matter curiously to the end
to examine and inquire; to investigate
to investigate to the bottom; to pursue an affair
to examine, inquire into and verify
entries.notes: 第二字“奩”与注音 sit 不合（奩音 liam），当为“实／悉”一类形讹，按“审实”义释义。

entries.en: to interrogate; to examine by questioning
to sound out, pry for news; to inquire by asking around
entries.notes: 注音栏杂有拉丁字母 “abrigur so.”，未能确解（疑为抄手旁注），不影响本条词义。

entries.en: to inquire of people; to gather information by inquiry
to seek out by inquiry; to look for

entries.zh: 暗访，密探；探询隐秘之事
entries.en: to inquire into secrets; to make secret, undercover inquiries
entries.notes: 汉字栏“徵”与注音 by（bi）不合（徵音 ting），“bi hong”合“微访／秘访”，据西语 ynquirir de secretos 取暗访义。

entries.zh: 采访；探询隐秘（探访求问）
entries.en: to inquire into secrets; to gather information by asking around
to pry into, sound out (secrets)
to probe for, seek out (secrets)

entries.zh: 考察；查核（依例审查核办）
entries.en: to examine, investigate; to inquire after the manner of a residencia (formal review of an official's conduct)
entries.notes: 西语含推断补文 “[por manera] de [residen]cia”，按马尼拉殖民地官员离任述职审查（residencia）制度理解。

entries.en: to seek out by inquiry; to search for by asking around
to ask around, sound out (for news or secrets)
